```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Combine concentration outputs

This section intentionally leaves study-specific classifications out of the
template. Add them using the metadata columns required by your project.

```{r}
read_concentrations <- function(analyte) {
  path <- file.path("Concentrations", analyte)
  files <- list.files(path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(files) == 0) {
    stop("No concentration files found in ", path)
  }

  map_dfr(files, read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(
      sample_id = Sample_ID,
      replication = Replication,
      concentration = Concentration,
      analyte = analyte
    )
}

results <- bind_rows(
  read_concentrations("Nitrate"),
  read_concentrations("Nitrite")
)

write_csv(results, "tidied_data.csv")
```

For study-specific site names, event dates, dilution handling, and joins,
create a separate project script rather than modifying the reusable analysis
steps.
